intelligence.human_view: You are not looking at a page. You are holding a world that knows you. Every button is a real thing you can press — deep, lit, with weight. Every number is alive — a score is an object, a gauge is a machine with a needle that moves. If one button on the page is elite and another is flat, the page is not Naya. Fix the flat one.
intelligence.simple_view: A slide show, not a spelling list. Each slide is one picture that says everything — you look, you tap, it moves, you go to the next. Nobody reads a whole book on one page. You flip, slide by slide, and every slide is alive when you touch it.
intelligence.grandma_view: A photo album, not a roll of film. One photo per page, each one framed, each one telling its story at a glance — and you turn the page for the next. The album is the deck. The page you are looking at is the whole world for that moment.
intelligence.naya_view: I am Anaya. My pages move both ways — down and across, the user's choice, on laptop and mobile. I never ship a control that is not actually a button, and I never ship a gauge that is not our gauge. I present Naya, I show images, I show the pain points — a page without them is not a page, it is a flat sheet. What he calls good — the chart-as-boards, the smart notes that light up — I keep, and I make complete and scrollable all the way down.
